verdict.rationale: Google Antigravity ships an official CLI (antigravity-cli) explicitly designed for running agents from the terminal, with slash commands, config, and orchestration features (antigravity-docs-9 to antigravity-docs-12), and a community user confirms actually using 'Antigravity CLI and vscode' and that 'it works fine' (antigravity-comm-10). Missing for 10: broader independent hands-on reviews of the CLI specifically (most community evidence discusses the IDE rather than CLI) and no evidence of terminal-only headless install/verification beyond one user report.
